# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.2.5 for macOS

- Fixes timing shifts when changing stem volumes on MP3 tracks containing encoder metadata. All seven stem versions now align with the player’s full-mix timeline.
- Marks affected older stem banks as Needs regeneration. Select those tracks and regenerate them to apply the timing fix; repacking an old bank does not correct its timing.
- Adds adjustable track-table columns, reserves room for progress indicators, and preserves your scroll position during packaging.
- Groups playlists with their USB drive and makes stems-tab notices and track errors dismissible.
- Keeps Automatic and Manual explanations and separation-quality guidance visible in Settings, with clearer concurrency guidance.
- Requires a reply email address when creating a support report.
